anchoredLines.line: 🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Ellis Weber. From Thornfield." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 2 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Rafael Santos. From Emberhold." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."

🌒 Dusk. They come out of the treeline in a knot — 1 of them, thin and road-worn — and stop at the edge of your firelight like they're not sure they're allowed closer. The oldest steps forward. "Fatima Petrov. From Ashford." A pause. "We're asking for a fire."
🌪️ THE HERALD fed in the night — 1,440 kcal gone from your stores. It is eating the realm while you deliberate.
📯 THE CALL GOES OUT — THE HERALD must fall, and no one fire can do it.
— Emberhold answers! Ellis Garcia and Peter Weber and Zoe Petrov and Marcus Novak and Maya Ford and Kira Cohen will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— Thornfield answers! Yuki Fischer and Nadia Frost will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
— The Hungry Road II answers! Mei Mendez and Hank Dubois will march. (trust holds — they are counting on you.)
